headline: Franklin Pierce ends Gannon's unbeaten run
dek: Franklin Pierce shut out Gannon after Gannon had beaten Kutztown, ending an unbeaten stretch that began in early September. The defeat was only Gannon's third in a season of eighteen wins and three draws, during which it scored 48 goals and conceded fifteen.
displaced_by: Franklin Pierce beat Gannon to end its unbeaten run after Gannon beat Kutztown
